title: herring
summary: A fish-name mystery around the North Sea.
question: Does a northern sound prove a Viking borrowing?
completion: Herring continues Old English hæring. Dutch haring and German Hering are cousins. Danish sild names the same fish on another trail. The earliest beginning of herring is still uncertain.
partner: A familiar word can carry a surprising history. Follow the evidence!
